# SYNTHETIC fixtures (not captured from any host)

Everything in this directory was written by hand or generated by code for the
telemetry v1 / sentinel tests (`docs/fleet-protocol.md` section 8.1). None of it
is labelled as real hardware output; the real, sanitized x299 capture lives in
`../x299/` (see its `CAPTURE.md`).

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `hwmon-with-fans/sys/class/hwmon/` | `nct6798` chip with `fan*_input`, `pwm*`, `pwm*_enable` + a `coretemp` package (case 8.2-3) |
| `powercap-readable/sys/class/powercap/` | readable `energy_uj.{0,1,2}`; package-0 wraps between `.0` and `.1` (case 8.2-9) |
| `powercap-multiwrap/sys/class/powercap/` | dram counter for the ambiguous long-interval case (case 8.2-9) |
| `nvidia-smi-na.csv` | `[N/A]`, `[Not Supported]` and an empty cell (case 8.2-4) |
| `nvidia-smi-permuted-header.csv` | header in a different field order, with units (parse by name, case 8.2-4) |
| `nvidia-smi-garbage.csv` | truncated row, error text, non-numeric index (case 8.2-4) |
| `fake-nvidia-smi.py` | stand-in tool: modes `ok`, `timeout`, `stall`, `exit`/`exit-9`, `na` (cases 8.2-5/6/7) |
| `boot_id.a`, `boot_id.b` | boot pair for reboot detection (case 8.2-12) |
| `sentinel-state-prev.json` | sentinel `state.json` of the previous boot (case 8.2-12) |
| `heartbeat-{alive,stale,rebooted}.json` | `atlas.heartbeat.v1` documents for the F0 validators |
| `queue-records/legacy-b7a47f5-*.md` | records rendered by the b7a47f5 queue code (case 8.3-1) |
| `queue-records/fleet-v1-claimed.md` | record with `spec.requirements`, extended `owner` and a claim `fleet` block (case 8.3-2) |
| `queue-records/schema_b7a47f5.py` | verbatim copy of `schema.py` at b7a47f5, imported by the 8.3-2 test |

RAPL zone directories are stored with U+F03A instead of `:` (what MSYS/Cygwin
write on NTFS); `telemetry_v1.ReplayReaders` accepts both spellings on every OS.
